### Strive Announces $1.0 Billion SATS At-The-Market Program


October 26, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/435279266/files/doc_news/Strive-Announces-1-0-Billion-SATS-At-The-Market-Program-2026.pdf)


DALLAS, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Strive, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASST; SATA; SATS) (“Strive” or the “Company”) today announced that it has entered into a sales agreement pursuant to which Strive may issue and sell shares of its 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock, $0.001 par value per share (the “SATS Stock”), having an aggregate offering price of up to $1.0 billion (the “ATM Program”).


Strive intends to use the net proceeds from the ATM Program for general corporate purposes, including, among other things, the acquisition of bitcoin and bitcoin-related products and for working capital, the purchase of income generating assets to grow the Company’s business, other capital expenditures, and/or repurchases of shares of the Company’s Class A common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “Class A Common Stock”) or its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “SATA Stock”). Strive may also use such proceeds to fund acquisitions of businesses, assets or technologies that complement our current business, for the payment of cash dividends declared or expected to be declared by Strive’s board of directors from time to time on shares of any class or series of Strive’s preferred stock then outstanding, or for repayment of future indebtedness.


The SATS Stock, subject to the terms and conditions of the sales agreement, may be sold by the sales agents by any method that is deemed an “at the market offering” as defined in Rule 415(a)(4) promulgated under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended or any other method permitted by law.


The sale of SATS Stock under the ATM Program is only offered pursuant to a prospectus supplement, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on October 26, 2026 under the existing automatic shelf registration statement, which became effective on September 15, 2025 (File No. 333-290252), and the base prospectus contained therein.


**About Strive**


Strive is a structured finance company focused on disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation. We have strategically adopted bitcoin as our hurdle rate for capital deployment because of our fiduciary duty to maximize long-term value for stockholders and compound purchasing power over time.


Strive Asset Management, LLC, a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of Strive and an SEC-registered investment adviser, manages over $2.8 billion in assets.
